package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// UpdateCourseTechs updates course tech links.
type UpdateCourseTechs struct {
	Courses repository.CourseRepository
	Techs   repository.CourseTechRepository
	Tx      repository.TransactionManager
}

// Handle replaces techs for course.
func (uc UpdateCourseTechs) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string, techIDs []int) error {
	run := func(fn func(ctx context.Context) error) error {
		if uc.Tx != nil {
			return uc.Tx.WithTx(ctx, fn)
		}
		return fn(ctx)
	}
	return run(func(ctx context.Context) error {
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return uc.Techs.Replace(ctx, courseID, techIDs)
	})
}
